name: The Sound in My Heart
original_name: เสียงที่อยากได้ยิน
overview: The Sound in My Heart is a romantic musical drama that explores love, healing, and the power of music to connect people across different generations and dreams. The story follows Nueng, a young music producer who was once a member of a legendary boy band. As he faces intense internal family conflicts and struggles within the cutthroat music industry, he goes on a journey of self-discovery to find the true sound of his own heart. Along the way, his path intertwines with others, weaving together multiple romantic storylines across BL (Boys' Love), GL (Girls' Love), and BG (Boy-Girl) relationships as they all fight to protect their dreams and identities.
